body: Resuming 2026-10-13 per user: generated terrain must render and a Sandbox campaign boot on it; research the path before runtime rounds, no old crash probes. Acceptance A1: actual screenshot plus readiness/height identity for generated native scene; A2: Sandbox reaches active map state on same generated terrain with campaign/scene identity and query checks; A3: diagnostic opt-in isolation, official files and existing saves preserved, build/results documented. Root owns source integration/deployment/game process. Bounded sidecar traces Sandbox bootstrap using installed IL (no game control). Existing query evidence PID23904 retained but is not rendering/boot acceptance. Implementation path decision before first launch; each run needs a new hypothesis, bounded timeout and evidence. Full epic wrap/naval/generated-content/save scope remains separate and unaccepted.
